findings.problem: The trick says clase is class plus an E, but that would spell classe, and a learner would memorize the wrong spelling, since clase has only one S.
findings.fix: trick: CLASE sounds like class: drop one S and add an E at the end of the lesson.

back.es: the class (a lesson or school session; also a group of students, or a kind)
back.example: I have English class at eight.

note: The hint "lesson at school" is needed, because it separates this card from the "kind, sort" card, and it fits clase, the usual word for a class session, better than lección.
